player_prompt.intro:
O dula 2048 ka boradiso {board_size}x{board_size}. Toro ya gago ke go fihla tile ya {target_tile} ka go swara dinomoro tse difanang! 
Diphoofolo tse di lokile: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles di kwana mme di kgona kgolo ya dihlango tsa tsona.

invalid_move.no_change: Boto ga se ya fetoga - e ile ya kgetha tsela e fapanego.

outcome.win: Mabone, o fihlile {target_tile}! Skor ya boraro {score}.
outcome.lose: Ga go na diphoofolo. Tile e kgolokgolo {max_tile} - skor ya boraro {score}.
